settings.title: 3. Orders & Payment Processing
settings.content:
Orders placed through our website are subject to acceptance and availability. We support secure UPI, credit/debit cards, net banking, and Cash on Delivery (COD).

In the event of payment failure or suspected fraud, we reserve the right to cancel or place the order on hold.
